# Channels and age

## How clients split across channels

*Which share of clients uses only the branch, only digital channels, both, or none?*

Channel profile over the rolling year: none (no event), branch_only (branch operations only), digital_only (card or online, never the branch), mixed (branch and at least one digital channel).

| Profile | Share of clients | Interval |
|---|---|---|
| No event in the year | 5.3% | 95% CI 3.9% to 6.8% |
| Branch only | 15% | 95% CI 12% to 17% |
| Digital only | 29% | 95% CI 26% to 32% |
| Branch and digital | 51% | 95% CI 48% to 54% |

Context: n = 1,000 clients; 2023-10-02 to 2024-10-02; real extract, allow-listed aggregate; data fingerprint 85887a44d747.

Method: Whole-year channel profile of every client of the sample (client_360); shares with percentile intervals from a client bootstrap.

Caveats:

- A profile summarises the whole year: one branch visit makes a client mixed.
- Channels are the three files: ATM withdrawals and card payments count as card.

## The digital divide by age

*How do branch-only and digital-only shares change with age, and is there a gender gap?*

| Age band | Branch only | Digital only |
|---|---|---|
| <25 | 6.9% (95% CI 3.4% to 11%) | 31% (95% CI 25% to 38%) |
| 25-34 | 6.5% (95% CI 3.9% to 9.3%) | 35% (95% CI 31% to 40%) |
| 35-44 | 15% (95% CI 8.7% to 21%) | 24% (95% CI 17% to 31%) |
| 45-54 | 28% (95% CI 21% to 36%) | 25% (95% CI 19% to 33%) |
| 55-64 | 25% (95% CI 18% to 33%) | 27% (95% CI 20% to 35%) |
| 65+ | 33% (95% CI 20% to 46%) | 13% (95% CI 5.3% to 22%) |

The branch-only share differs between the two gender codes by
-1.5 percentage points
(95% CI -6.0 to +3.1 points).

**Robustness verdict: holds.** The headline compares
clients aged 55 and over against clients under 35. Crude difference in the branch-only share (clients aged 55 and over minus clients under 35): +21.3 points. Holding gender code fixed, the adjusted difference is +21.3 points. Holding tenure band fixed, the adjusted difference is +18.2 points. Strata of tenure band without enough clients of one group to compare: 11+ years. Verdict: holds.

Context: n = 1,000 clients; 2023-10-02 to 2024-10-02; real extract, allow-listed aggregate; data fingerprint 85887a44d747.

Method: Share of branch-only and digital-only clients in each age band (client_360, all clients of the band as denominator); gender gap as the difference of branch-only shares between the two gender codes; client bootstrap intervals. Headline robustness: branch-only share of clients aged 55 and over against clients under 35, within gender and tenure strata.

Caveats:

- Age is measured at extraction, not when the channel habits formed.
- Shares use every client of the band as denominator, including clients with no event.
- Gender codes are kept as codes; their meaning is assumed, not documented.
- The robustness check leaves activity level out: activity is partly a consequence of channel choice, so holding it fixed would bias the comparison.

## Who goes silent: branch-only against digital-only clients

*Are branch-only clients more likely than digital-only clients to have no event in the quarter after the observation window, and does that survive holding activity fixed?*

This headline is published as a robustness verdict only: its values, intervals and group sizes
stay in the private ledger. It is here to show the robustness checker at work on real data.

**Robustness verdict: reverses.** Stratifiers checked:
activity level (tercile of events); age band; tenure band. The effect changes sign within:
activity level (tercile of events).

Before stratification the silence rate is higher for branch-only clients than for digital-only clients. Holding activity level (tercile of events) fixed, the difference reverses its sign. Holding age band fixed, the difference keeps its sign. Holding tenure band fixed, the difference keeps its sign. Verdict: reverses. Mechanism: branch-only clients have fewer events in the observation window than digital-only clients; with few events a quarter without any is likely by chance, so the crude gap mostly measures activity, not channel.

Context: verdict only, no value published; 2023-10-02 to 2024-10-02; real extract; data fingerprint 85887a44d747.
